notes.title: Episode 2 Update: Final Destination Unlocked!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320616/58c346c01ab93b773ba6e57b2a94708befcd5b29.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320616/1bf9c57e2a5d977d70c2043dd6babbbe6498b250.png[/img][/url]

Episode 2 has been added. You can now play to the final destination.

Japanese language support has been added.

Fixed a bug where the vehicle could continue driving even after dropping an item.

Improved the character respawn system.

Fixed an item bug where mines could be used even when the count was 0.

[previewyoutube=Vj_aJGZjE74;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Demo Version Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320616/778167e543293a0f8c630781c58bbe5b5a4eaca4.png[/img]

Bug Fixes

Resolved an issue where item selection was not working.
Updates

Episode 0: Applied a patch to prevent duplicate activation in the shooting game.
Episodes 1 & 2: Modified the game start to automatically launch quest mode.
Episode 2: Expanded the playable area.
Optimization

Optimized file size by removing unnecessary data and improving performance.
Notes

Although still in an unfinished stage, we hope you enjoy the experience!
